usedFor: LinkedIn Campaign Manager collects lead form responses, and Asana receives a task through “Create Task or Subtask”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Sponsored Lead Form Response” in LinkedIn Campaign Manager, then “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: Each ad lead becomes a task with an assignee and due date, so follow up has an owner.

watchOut: Organic and sponsored lead forms are separate triggers, so set up one for each type you run.
